elements.title: 3.5.1130 Released on 9/2/2026
elements.contents:
3.5.1130 Released on 9/2/2026

Changed

  • When you turn off the “Disable the use of diagnostic data for a tailored user experience” settings (U004, U005), the Windows default value is now written instead of deleting the value
  • voice output and keyboard operation improved; decorative symbols are skipped and menu items have keyboard shortcuts in all eight program languages
  • Notification of changes denied by Windows explains cause and reset the switch
  • Upgrade uses the same verified installation component as automatic updates
  • Premium Edition and OEM editions are reliably detected based on setup data
  • PREM: Registry Changes Denied by Windows Are Logged with Value and Cause
  • PREM: Auto-Protection Denied Message Refers to Diagnostic Log and Support
  • PREM: New menu item “View → Hide settings protected by Windows”; Selection is saved
  • PREM: Settings protected by Windows are not counted as open deviations and are shown separately
  • PREM: Settings protected by Windows are locked, marked with a lock and can be checked again
  • PREM: Background service startup delay shortened to 30 seconds; Program waits during startup
  • PREM: Skipped update search shows the result of the previous search

Fixed

  • Settings U004 and U005 were repeatedly activated by Windows; as a result, O&O ShutUp10 reported new changes to the settings every time it was started, and the reversal of the change did not last
  • Secure Boot certificate status under Windows 11 24H2/25H2 is reliably detected
  • Ready Secure Boot certificates are displayed as a pending update instead of an error
  • Message about a protected Windows Insider setting translated into six more languages
  • Free Edition correctly references the application log for denied changes
  • User Account Control rejected when upgrading is reported; window remains open
  • AI tab no longer reports a Recall folder deletion error on Copilot+ PCs
  • PREM: Profiles that are already suitable can be set as active profiles
  • PREM: “Check for updates now” available again; repeated queries are limited
  • PREM: “Download new version” uses existing update data
  • PREM: Entire Machine tab updates as soon as the background service is available
  • PREM: Menu item “Start service…” follows the current service status
  • PREM: Updates are no longer offered when logging off, shutting down, or restarting
  • PREM: Start update search and dialog only once; dialog appears in the middle when the main window is hidden

Info

  • Compatible with Windows 11 and Windows 10; x86, x64 and ARM architecture
  • Available in English, French, German, Italian, Spanish, Russian and Chinese (Simplified)

3.4.1124 Released on 8/18/2026

Added

  • Disable Site Access Rights Override (P098)
  • Disable display of office.com files in Explorer (P099)
  • The factory reset is recorded in the change history and can be undone like other sessions

Improvements

  • Description “Disable WiFi Direct” (S119) lists affected features
  • Profile names limited to 64, notes to 1,000 characters; long names are shortened
  • Icons uniformly use 1-pixel line thickness in menus and profile management
  • Message when switching automatic protection distinguishes service error from change error
  • Background service errors are recorded in Windows Event Viewer and Diagnostic Log
  • Corrupted configuration files are reported at startup; change history is saved again
  • “Check online for new version” is omitted in Premium Edition (automatic search with notifications)

Corrections

  • “Disable automatic driver updates through Windows Update” (W010): Home uses edition-independent policy
  • “Disable automatic driver updates through Windows Update” (W010) uses persistent policy value (cannot be overridden)
  • “Don’t show this message again” reliably suppresses dialog
  • Note about disabled system restore points no longer appears on every change
  • Long profile name no longer obscures edit button
  • Message windows with long text are height-limited and scrollable
  • Symbols lie exactly on the pixel grid (not offset/blurred)
  • Automatic protection invites itself when service is busy; short-term errors are repeated
  • Failure to switch automatic protection does not result in a state change
  • “Disable app access to device location” no longer shows a double space
  • Non-existent settings are no longer monitored; blank shortcuts do not appear in messages
  • Undo with unreachable service: Error is reported, session is preserved
  • Error cause is reported correctly (not incorrectly “blocked by Windows”)
  • “Reset all settings” with unreachable service shows error message
  • “Restore original settings” reports error with unreachable service
  • Service outage: Write access is rechecked and failure is reported
  • Undo runs in the background (non-blocking) when the service is unresponsive
  • Automatic protection without hybrid mode: Login enforcement is only done once, ongoing deviations are monitored at a reduced rate
  • After factory default: Policy subkeys are cleaned up by the service
  • Info dialog shows actual result of the last update search
  • Program window opens in the foreground (not minimized) via notification area icon
  • Dialogs use normal window background (not gray)
  • Language directories are installed in the new directory when updating

Info

  • Compatible with Windows 11 and Windows 10; x86, x64 and ARM architecture
  • Available in English, French, German, Italian, Spanish, Russian and Chinese (Simplified)

Version 3.3.1119 released on 08/04/2026

Added

  • Disable app access to passkeys for all users (P086)
  • Disable app access to Bluetooth devices for all users (P087)
  • Disable app access to input devices (HID) for all users (P088)
  • Disable app access to the list of saved passkeys for all users (P089)
  • Disable app access to custom sensors for all users (P090)
  • Disable app access to serial ports for all users (P091)
  • Disable app access to USB devices for all users (P092)
  • Disable app access to Wi-Fi information for all users (P093)
  • Disable app access to Wi-Fi Direct for all users (P094)
  • Disable app access to passkeys for current user (P186)
  • Disable app access to Bluetooth devices for current users (P187)
  • Disable App Access to Input Devices (HID) for Current User (P188)
  • Disable app access to the list of saved passkeys for current users (P189)
  • Disable app access to custom sensors for current user (P190)
  • Disable app access to serial ports for current user (P191)
  • Disable app access to USB devices for current users (P192)
  • Disable app access to Wi-Fi information for current users (P193)
  • Disable app access to Wi-Fi Direct for current users (P194)
  • A notice banner on the “Local Computer” tab states the reason for unavailable computer-wide settings and offers the appropriate remedy directly
  • A lock icon indicates settings that are specified by a global configuration file
  • The new change history records the last 10 sessions and allows you to undo single or multiple sessions
  • “Actions ▸ Undo ▸ Restore Original Settings” restores the state recorded when the application was first started
  • PREM: The most recently applied profile and the number of currently matching settings are displayed on the overview page and under “Manage Profiles…”

Improvements

  • After the letter, it will check whether Windows has blocked the change and, if necessary, report this accordingly
  • The commands for undoing changes are combined with their own icons in the new submenu “Actions ▸ Undo”
  • PREM: The revised “Manage Profiles…” dialog explains the profile function, highlights the applied profile and rearranges the buttons
  • PREM: “Apply” is now only available if the selected profile would change the current state

Corrections

  • “Disable Windows location service” (L005) did not remain enabled on Windows 10 through Windows 11 23H2 and now permanently disables the service above its startup (restart required)
  • “Disable Application Telemetry” (U001) could be incorrectly displayed as disabled despite the policy being applied because an edition-dependent mirror value was evaluated
  • Settings that did not reach the background service were incorrectly reported as “blocked by Windows” on the AI page
  • Unapplied settings are now logged with ID and cause
  • Open menus could get behind other windows and are now closed when focus is lost
  • Many buttons, including the title bar buttons, did not have a name that was readable by screen readers
  • PREM: Changes to the availability status of the O&O ShutUp10 service were not taken into account in the status bar and in the “Automatic Protection” during the program runtime
  • PREM: A single timeout could cause all subsequent changes to fail when applying many settings

Removed

  • PREM: The “Undo” button has been removed from “Manage Profiles…” as changes are now undone centrally via “Actions ▸ Undo”

Info

  • Compatible with Windows 11 and Windows 10; x86, x64 and ARM architecture
  • Available in English, French, German, Italian, Spanish, Russian and Chinese (Simplified)

elements.title: 1.3.1359 – published on 8/10/2016
elements.contents:
1.3.1359 – published on 8/10/2016

  • Consideration of Windows 10 Anniversary Update (Version 1607 Redstone 1)
        – Wi-Fi Sense is no longer offered, so disabling this feature is obsolete
        – Various group policies have been changed in their validity, but this has not yet affected O&O ShutUp10
        – Cortana can no longer be disabled via Windows Settings; but with O&O ShutUp10 as before ;-)
  • Disabling OneDrive is no longer conditionally recommended, but not recommended
        – Some users use OneDrive for data backup and will no longer have access to the features offered by disabling them
        – To avoid accidental disabling, we have set the recommendation level to “not recommended”
  • Tooltips explain the importance of the pictograms for the recommendation level
  • The Windows 10 version (Threshold 1, Threshold 2 and Redstone 1) is now also displayed on the info page to make it easier to communicate with our support
  • Minor bug fixes

1.3.1358 – published on 6/14/2016

  • The command line option “/quiet” was not correctly taken into account during import
  • New /nosrp option prevents recovery point (SRP) creation
        – This applies to import via command line, especially in combination with “/quiet”
        – The option also applies to the normal launch of the application, so no more SRPs are created
  • Minor bug fixes

1.3.1357 – Posted on 5/30/2016

  • Status light when creating a system restore point
  • Dialog for restarting when exiting O&O ShutUp10 if necessary
  • Reworked the creation of the system restore point
  • Minor bug fixes

1.3.1356 – Posted on 3/10/2016

  • Postponing upgrades no longer defers security updates
  • Advanced exception handling integrated:
        – When starting O&O ShutUp10 under the German Windows 10 Insider Build 14279, the German version of O&O ShutUp10 crashes.
        – This crash is also understandable in other applications that do not originate from us.

elements.title: 1.2.1353 – published on 12/2/2015
elements.contents:
1.2.1353 – published on 12/2/2015

  • Italian integrated as a new language (in addition to English, German, French and Russian)
  • Changed settings when loading an admin profile in the user context are now counted correctly
  • In user mode, settings can now be exported correctly
  • Removed “Skype” from the apps settings because it does not exist as an app

1.2.1352 – Posted on 11/18/2015

  • French language version integrated (in addition to English, German and Russian)
  • Setting several settings via the action menu now correctly takes into account the user’s authorization
  • The display of settings for users who do not have administrative permission is automatically disabled
  • The size of the application window can be freely changed
  • Minor fixes

  • Minor fixes

  • Some users have observed a problem with loading resources on their system, which is fixed with this version

1.2.1349 – published on 11/3/2015

  • Start of the application and options of the settings now also possible for non-administrators
  • Extensions for Windows Defender and Microsoft SpyNet
  • Import of settings via command line possible
  • Extension of the Quick Start Guide
  • Application now has a single, executable file (previously ZIP directory)
  • Minor fixes in the user interface
